items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: With his band. John Wheeler's Ginger Band. ... They had a sign up. John Wheeler's Jazz Band. ... replaced it with John Wheeler's Ginger Band.

ctx.x: I said, Mama, can you see my knees shaking?

I said, no. It felt like it was doing like that. Yeah, it was funny. Yeah. This band, you see, they introduced me to running from home. Because I couldn't work here, nobody did know me in Milwaukee. And it was the first long pantsuit I ever had in my life. We got off the train and they waited for the pawn shop to open. Went in there and bought me a long, a first long pantsuit. It was a tuxedo. I can't stand them today. Yeah. Well, you went to Milwaukee. At Slick's Palm Garden. With his band. John Wheeler's Ginger…
